item.name: Frozen Dimension
item.overview: The Frozen Dimension exclusively spawns in Sea Danger Level 6 (????).

item.name: Ghost Ship Raid
item.overview: In the Ghost Ship Raid, only one ship will spawn with an aquamarine color and attacks the player's ship with cannons, as well as two Ghost Sharks and some Haunted Crew Members.

item.name: Haunted Crew Member
item.overview: The Haunted Crew Members also leave a bluish-green glow similar to Ghost's Resurrection Passive.

item.name: Haunted Ship Raid
item.overview: Haunted Ship Raids can spawn at Sea Danger Level 1-6.

item.name: Haunted Shipwreck
item.overview: The Haunted Shipwreck may only spawn if the player is sailing a Boat in Sea Danger Level 6 (????). This island will despawn:

item.name: Kitsune Island
item.overview: "A mysterious shrine has appeared in the sea..."

item.name: Kitsune Shrine
item.overview: The Kitsune Shrine is a shrine where players can interact with a boulder engraved with the transformed Kitsune's silhouette to obtain various in-game items.

item.name: Leviathan
item.overview: The Leviathan can be summoned by the Frozen Watcher.

item.name: Mirage Island
item.overview: The Mirage Island is a special island that functions differently from all the other islands. It is the place where the Advanced Fruit Dealer, and the Blue Gear for Race Awakening are located.

item.name: Piranha
item.overview: Piranhas are capable of leaping out of the water to attack both the player's boat and the player directly. They utilize biting and electric shocks as their primary forms of attack. When a player is hit by a Piranha, their ability to dash, jump, and use abilities is temporarily disabled. Piranhas will automatically despawn if they move too far from their original spawn point. Notably, they prioritize targeting the player over the boat and cannot be damaged using M1 attacks from fighting styles or swords.

item.name: Prehistoric Island
item.overview: To spawn the Prehistoric Island, players need to sail into Sea Danger Level 6 (????) and continue exploring until the island appears. The island can spawn even if the player in the boat does not have the Volcanic Magnet, but having it increases the chances of the island spawning drastically. Thus, it is recommended for at least one player to have a Volcanic Magnet in the sea exploration group if they're hunting for the Prehistoric Island.

item.name: Rough Sea
item.overview: The Rough Sea is a randomly spawned sea event that clears surrounding rocks, dims the area inside the sea, and spawns lightning that can damage players and their boats. The Sharks and Piranhas can spawn in and will target players. The Rough Sea can spawn at any Sea Danger Level arranging from Sea Danger Level 1 (Low) to Sea Danger Level 6 (????), and is able to be spawned without a boat. Additionally, in the Second Sea, the Rough Sea can also spawn.

item.name: Rumbling Waters
item.overview: The Rumbling Waters is a sea event composed of three Sea Beasts.

item.name: Sea Beast

item.name: Shark (Enemy)
item.overview: The Sharks randomly spawn in groups of 1-5 in Second Sea and in Sea Danger Level 0-6 in Third Sea (can also spawn in First sea for easter event)

item.name: Ship Raid
item.overview: The Ship Raid has a chance to happen when the player sails across the sea in a boat. It has two Brigade ships, and a chance to have a Grand Brigade, which will constantly shoot cannonballs at their ship. They will despawn after they successfully destroy the player's boat/ship or if they go far enough away. The player can sink these ships by firing their cannons at them or using AoE moves against them.

item.name: Terrorshark
item.overview: The Terrorshark has a chance to spawn between Sea Danger Levels 2-6. When spawned, it will swim around the player(s) boat and constantly attack the player(s) until the boat/target dies. As the Sea Danger Level increases, the Terrorshark will progressively get stronger and harder to defeat. It is recommended to not go past Danger Level 5 as the Terrorsharks that spawn there are very powerful. Although higher levels do not increase health, they will carry more sharks and do greater damage. It is also almost impossible to escape from the Terrorshark, however fast fruits, such as Light, and boats, such as The Sentinel can sometimes outrun them.

item.name: Treasure Island
item.overview: The Treasure Island is relatively small and consists of three distinct sections, each at a different elevation. A few trees and rocks are scattered across the terrain, with a chance for Chests to spawn. Aside from these features, the island is largely barren.
